# Material Symbols assets

The Android VectorDrawables named `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_symbol_*.xml` are Material Symbols Outlined 24dp assets from Google's `material-design-icons` repository at revision `e083cc60a0828fdd3b404cea0cb8a5b900e9c23e`.

Source layout:

```text
symbols/android/<token>/materialsymbolsoutlined/<token>_24px.xml
```

The source `?attr/colorControlNormal` tint was replaced with a resource-safe white fallback. Compose applies the actual semantic content tint when rendering. Icon geometry is otherwise unchanged.
